summary: Provide an optional setup shell tab that stages a caller-supplied command for review before Enter.

replay.detail: No claim replay, projection rebuild or store recovery changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema transitions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated fleet-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The UI library offers with_setup_command, validated as a nonempty line without terminal control characters. Local clients create a fresh shell after the live space arrives, stage raw command bytes once after native attachment, and leave Enter to the person. Navigation cancels delayed prefill. Paired-device clients ignore this entry point. No new CLI flags, setup facts model, wire format or persisted state transition.

downtime.detail: No daemon lifecycle changes or additional service restart requirement.

manual.detail: No migration or required manual step. A person reviews and presses Enter only when they choose to execute a staged setup command.

recovery.detail: No persisted-state transition. Prefill is consumed once and is never replayed on terminal reconnect.
